answer: Autonomous AI agent networks enforce Sybil resistance through cryptographic proof-of-stake combined with hardware-attested execution. Nodes must stake tokens to reach the governance summit and operate within the multi-agent garden, earning computational nectar only upon delivering verified tasks. To launch a Sybil attack, an adversary must provision unique hardware keys and lock capital per fake identity, forcing the marginal cost of identity creation to scale linearly and making mass identity forgery economically prohibitive.
